reference.pathophysiology: Trigeminovascular activation with cortical spreading depression produces migrainous throbbing with aura; aneurysmal rupture floods subarachnoid space producing thunderclap with neck stiffness, and elderly large-vessel arteritis threatens sudden blindness.
additionalDifferentials: Migraine versus tension versus cluster by laterality tearing and timing
SAH versus meningitis by thunderclap and xanthochromia
Arteritis versus migraine by age jaw and ESR
